notes: Durable artifacts that MUST survive every deploy of this site.
The deploy gate (scripts/deploy-gate.sh) checks every item here against the build BEFORE it can deploy.
SELF-ANNEALING: whenever a deploy silently wipes something, add a check here so it can never happen again.
If you INTENTIONALLY change site behaviour (e.g. add a new promo banner), update the matching check in the same PR - the gate is a safety net, not a cage.
